start.what: Agent can snooze a ticket until a time. Hidden from inbox. Comes back by itself, live.
start.why: PR #142: tickets waiting on a customer reply get lost in the inbox.

inbox filter + due query decide what inbox shows

diagram.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant W as web
  participant C as Controller
  participant S as TicketsService
  participant R as Repository
  participant RC as Redis
  W->>C: PATCH /tickets/42/snooze (until, note)
  alt bad JWT
    C-->>W: 401
  else until in past
    C-->>W: 400
  end
  C->>S: snooze(tenant, 42, until, user)
  S->>R: findOne(tenant, 42)
  alt not found
    S-->>W: 404
  else closed
    S-->>W: 409
  end
  S->>R: setSnooze
  S->>RC: DEL inbox:tenant
  S-->>W: 200 Ticket

sequenceDiagram
  participant CR as Cron
  participant S as TicketsService
  participant R as Repository
  participant WS as Gateway
  CR->>S: wakeDue(now)
  S->>R: findDueSnoozed(now), any status
  loop each due ticket
    S->>R: wake(id): status = open
    S->>WS: ticket.woke
  end
  Note over CR,WS: runs on every api instance
